english.title: My First Alchemy Set
english.objective: Bring 5 Empty Vials, 5 Silverleaf, and 5 Peacebloom to the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in Westfall.
english.progress: 'Ello again! Did you bring back alchemy stuff?
english.complete:
Oh my gosh! Look at these! Did you pick the herbs yourself?

Wow, thanks mister, I am going to see what I can make with these right now! Do you want to watch?
english.detail:
Erm... 'Ello, <mister/miss>. I'm not supposed to talk to strangers, but... Hey, what are those shiny bottles sticking out of your backpack for? Are you an alchemist? That's so cool!

When I grow up, I want to be an alchemist too. Daddy won't let me play with any of his herbs; too dangerous, he says.

Well, I want to start learning now. Could you maybe get some supplies for me, pretty please?

english.title: My First Real Potion
english.objective: Gather 3 Murloc Eyes for the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in Westfall.
english.progress: Don't worry about me, I'm a big girl. I can take care of myself. Just don't tell anyone I am hiding here, it's our little secret.
english.complete:
You brought me murloc eyes! I am so excited for my first REAL potion I can't breathe!

I snuck out and grabbed a few more herbs while you were away and found some empty vials downstairs. Um... you can do the mixing this time.

<The child watches enthusiastically you mix the ingredients, but her nose crumples as you add the eyes. The concoction takes on a sickly orange in mere seconds.>

Wow! See, I was right. I wouldn't drink that, but here's my recipe if you wanted to make more. Come back sometime!
english.detail:
Wow, my very first potion! Did you know that mixing those two herbs together would change the potion to a bright red color when you first started?

That was fun, but mixing a few flowers doesn't seem like the kind of alchemy Daddy does. He uses other ingredients too.

I don't know what else to use, so let's try the first thing that comes to mind! Let's see... maybe murloc eyes? That sounds so gross, but I bet something will happen.

english.title: Harvesting the Harvesters
english.objective: Bring the Precessive Autocognition Assembly to Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm.
english.complete: What's this?
english.detail: The part you managed to salvage from the harvester appears mostly intact. Someone interested in harvest golems may want to see it.

english.title: Harvesting the Harvesters
english.objective: Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm wants you to bring him 8 Golem Isosprings, 4 Copper Modulators, and a Crude Scope.
english.progress: How's the project coming, <name>?
english.complete:
Here it is, <name>! Should work great. Go give it a try!

...Me? No, I'll stay here. It's starting to feel like home, anyway.
english.detail:
I see... this gives me some insight into what makes those monsters tick. I have an idea how we could override their systems, at least momentarily.

I'll continue tinkering with the assembly you brought me. In the meantime, could you scrounge up some parts for the device?

english.title: Oh Brother...
english.objective: Bring Foreman Thistlenettle's Explorers' League Badge to Wilder Thistlenettle in Stormwind.
english.progress: Did you find any sign of my brother?  Is there any hope after all this time?
english.complete: My suspicions were correct.  My poor brother.... Well, thank you for bringing some conclusion to this mystery, even if the conclusion was grim.
english.detail:
We were deep in a vast mine in Westfall, hidden beneath a barn in Moonbrook. No clue where these stinkin' thieving types came from. Anyway, the mine tunnel collapsed on us. I got out but the others... well... the others haven't been heard from.

You look like you might have better luck in there. If you could look for my brother, I'd be thankful.  He always carried his Explorers' League Badge. If you can't find him, that badge would at least give me some peace of mind.

english.title: Collecting Memories
english.objective: Retrieve 4 Miners' Union Cards and return them to Wilder Thistlenettle in Stormwind.
english.progress: Were you able to retrieve any of my old co-worker's Miners' Union Cards?
english.complete: Thank you for collecting these, <name>.  Your efforts will help bring peace to the dead in the wake of this tragedy.  I will see to it that the families are notified.
english.detail: Many of my friends perished that horrible day when the mine tunnel caved in.  If your adventures happen to bring you into that wing of the mine in Moonbrook, please keep an eye out for any sign which might identify them.  If you come across any of their Miners' Union Cards, bring them back to me and I'll make sure their families get some resolution from this horrible accident.

english.title: Underground Assault
english.objective: Retrieve the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket from the Deadmines and return it to Shoni the Shilent in Stormwind.
english.progress: Have you found the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket, <name>?
english.complete: Well done, <name>. Thanks to you, Gnomeregan is one step closer to its day of liberation!
english.detail:
Gnomeregan has fallen under the control of those dastardly troggs! The situation is grave but perhaps you can help, <name>.

Deep in the Deadmines is a functional goblin shredder. Find that shredder and bring back the intact power supply. With the shredder's power supply, we can give our gyrodrillmatic excavationators the power they need to break through the rocky underground borders of Gnomeregan, opening the way for a gnomish assault!

2040.sourceNote: 60.tools capitalizes one <Name> marker in the offer. The primary English source uses <name> and controls casing in this pack.

english.title: The Quarry's Smith
english.objective: Collect 12 Copper Bars and 4 Toughened Boar Hides and deliver them to Frast Dokner.
english.progress: Don't slack off, <name>. Smithin' isn't for the lazy!
english.complete:
You're a resourceful one, <name>.

Now listen up - I'm not going to repeat myself!
english.detail:
So you're looking to learn the blacksmith's trade? Maybe we can help each other.

The supply shipment's late, and I need materials for some repairs around the camp. If you get me what I need, I'll teach you some of my techniques. Sound fair?

english.title: Excavation Tools
english.objective: Return 6 Excavation Tools to Magmar Fellhew.
english.progress: We just, uh, need to adjust our dig site and we can get this whole thing back on track!
english.complete:
Our tools!

When the troggs overran the camp, we had to leave most of our tools behind. This'll be a big help once we get this invasion under control and can start working again!
english.detail: The excavation's tools, left behind when the dwarves fled from the troggs, seem mostly untouched. Returning them to the excavators will surely aid their work.

english.title: Twisting the Knife
english.objective: Find and defeat the crocolisk Daggerfang and bring back Marek's knife.
english.progress: How goes the huntin'?
english.complete:
Hah! You did it! I never thought that ol' croc would get its comeuppance, but that does the trick!

Oh ah... y'know, I had to get me another knife, but maybe that one will bring you some good luck. Why don't you hang onto it?
english.detail:
Did I ever tell you how I almost lost me hand to a crocolisk? Managed to jam me knife into its jaw, and scrambled out real quick. I thought I had the knife around here somewhere, but I can't seem to find it.

Anyway, that croc is probably still out there hunting along the edge of the lake. That nasty brute probably needs to go, for the safety of the other hunters, if nothing else.

I've taken to calling it Daggerfang. If you see it, give it a friendly hello from me! And by "hello" I mean "stab."

english.title: Darkness in the Glade
english.objective: Collect Hatescreech's Amulet, Windmistress Gaedress' Amulet, and Witchmother Arysa's Amulet for Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak in the Oracle Glade.
english.progress: Have you wrested the amulets from the harpies' leaders?
english.complete:
<Arynia investigates the amulets.>

Do you see the foul green swirls within the gems? This is indeed fel moss corruption at work.

I have heard similar reports from Shadowglen and elsewhere in the boughs of this substance turning our very world against us.

I will inform my superiors of this at once.
english.detail:
These belts... look closely at the leather, <name>. Do you see the taint running through the fibers?

I have a suspicion as to its origin, but we will need further proof to be sure.

Venture back out into the harpies' nests to the west and take out their leaders. If their necklaces carry the same darkness as these belts, we'll have our answer.

english.title: The Oracle Tree
english.objective: Find the Oracle Tree Bark nearby to receive its message.
english.complete: As you inspect the fallen bark, a voice enters your mind. It is calm and soothing, cresting over you like a gentle breeze through the leaves.
english.detail:
I am impressed by what you have accomplished here in so short a time, <name>. Would that I could ask you to remain here to assist me with my duties... but I know in my heart that greater tasks lie ahead for you.

I have noticed the Oracle Tree has just shed a piece of its bark. No doubt it has a task that it wishes completed. You should speak with it.

english.title: A Simmering Storm
english.objective: Bring the Dull Stormy Orb to Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.
english.complete: Woah, where did you find a neat thing like that? Ya know it reminds me of the other thing my boss Gazlowe always used to tell me...
english.detail:
<Before you is a strange orb with a dull surface. When picked up a small electrical current seems to vibrate from within. Upon closer inspection, it looks as if a dark mist swirls within and every so often a small electrical spark can be seen.

It is clear the harpy was using it for some purpose. Perhaps Rezlak would be interested in this object?>

english.title: Stormy Potential
english.objective: Bring 5 Charged Thunder Lizard Organs to Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.
english.progress:
It might come as a surprise that with a name like thunder lizard they shoot lightning instead of roaring like thunder.

Well, they do. Shoot lightning, I mean.

Trust me, it's a lesson you only get to learn once if you're lucky.
english.complete:
Hey, thanks pal! You've been a really big help to me here and I appreciate it.

Here's to hoping I can get this all charged up using these organs. I bet it'll make those no good harpies think twice about attacking my caravan again. I sure hope this works.

Either way you've done your side of the deal. Take this for your trouble.
english.detail:
"Rezlack, when an opportunity comes knocking make sure you're ready to seize it." That's another gem Gazlowe taught me and that's exactly what I intend to do.

This orb doesn't seem damaged, it just looks like it's out of juice, but I've the idea to supercharge it back to full strength!

There are a bunch of thunder lizards in a gorge west of here. They have organs that hold a strong electrical charge that would be perfect for this.

Go harvest some and bring them back to me!

english.title: Stalk With The Earthmother
english.objective: Sneak into the Venture Company mine southeast of Thunder Bluff and collect 5 Seaforium Mining Charges from carts of blasting supplies, then return them to Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff.
english.progress: We'll need to work on your stealth skills, <class>. I heard you approaching as soon as you set foot on the mesa.
english.complete: Hmm... perhaps disguises are not your strength.
english.detail: I sense in you a hidden talent for the subtle arts, <class>. Use this mask to infiltrate the nearby Venture Company mine and steal their supplies. It may not seem like a convincing disguise, but a skilled rogue can slip past any guard with naught but a winning smile and a cunning distraction. I believe this capability lies within you as well.

76156.sourceNote: Mulgore quest chain. Skyborne live eligibility is unverified.

english.title: Stalk With The Earthmother
english.objective: Gather 8 Windfury Cones north of Thunder Bluff, use them with the Mortar and Pestle, then return to Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff with the result.
english.progress: Be careful with the salve once you are finished, <class>.  Even skin contact could be quite painful.
english.complete:
<class>, this is not the venomous salve I asked for.  What you have brought me is pine nut butter.  Are you sure you followed my instructions?

This will be of far more use spread on some spice bread than on a dagger.  Although you would be quite formidable against a foe with a nut allergy.
english.detail: Maybe your skills lie with poisons, not disguises. The Harpies to the north nest in a tree which produces a resin of potent toxicity. Gather the fallen cones around the nests, then crush them into a salve. When applied to a blade this salve will sear your opponent's wounds into their flesh and turn their blood to salt.

76160.sourceNote: Mulgore quest chain. Skyborne live eligibility is unverified.

english.title: Stalk With The Earthmother
english.objective: Buy or catch a Raw Brilliant Smallfish, then use the Knife Set to fillet it in front of Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff.
english.progress: Do you have something for me?
english.complete:
That was quite a display, <class>.  Not the rogueish precision I hoped for, but you possess an impressive ambidexterity.

I see now that you will not be the one to train my people in the subtle arts, but there is one thing I can teach you.  Good luck on your travels, <class>.  The Horde will need heroes like you.
english.detail:
I have one last idea that may lead us to success. I still feel there is hidden talent in you, but let us try and coax it out with a less direct approach.

Go and procure a Raw Brilliant Smallfish, then bring it back here. Use these daggers to clean and fillet it. Do not think too hard - do what comes naturally.

76240.sourceNote: Mulgore quest chain. Skyborne live eligibility is unverified.

english.title: Prove Your Worth
english.objective: Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher wants you to kill 5 Moonrage Whitescalps.
english.progress: If you wish to prove yourself to me, you must kill 5 Moonrage Whitescalps.  Accomplish that task, and I will see to it your skill is put to more worthy assignments.
english.complete: You have served me well, <class>.  It is obvious to me that you will be a worthy aide to me as I prepare to rid Silverpine Forest of Arugal's curse.
english.detail:
Lady Sylvanas has charged Varimathras with the conquering of the human and dwarven lands to the south.

But that fool, Arugal -- charlatan of Dalaran and now cursed beast of Shadowfang Keep -- let his reckless magic wreak havoc with the strategic stronghold of Silverpine Forest.

I need someone skilled in the ways of combat to help clean up Arugal's mess.  Prove yourself to me by killing 5 Moonrage Whitescalps.  The wretched beasts can often be found just off the road, down the hill below.

english.title: Arugal's Folly
english.objective: Retrieve the Remedy of Arugal for Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
english.progress: Before I know what we are dealing with here, <class>, I need to study the spell known as Remedy of Arugal.  Bring it to me now or I shall be forced to find myself a worthy servant.
english.complete: This is precisely the spell I was in search of, <class>.  If your dedication to The Dark Lady's cause remains infallible you will find you have quite a future amongst The Forsaken.
english.detail:
How Arugal gained acceptance within the Kirin Tor is beyond me.  His spell-casting knowledge seemed as transparent as a blown glass bauble.

What's important now is learning exactly what magic Arugal used so that I can turn it against him and secure Silverpine Forest for the Dark Lady.

Arugal first stayed at the wheat farm just north of the bridge.  One of the Deathstalkers reported seeing some spellbooks but could not secure them.  Retrieve for me the spell labeled Remedy of Arugal from those books.

english.title: Arugal's Folly
english.objective: Bring 6 Glutton Shackles and 3 Darksoul Shackles to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
english.progress: I will need 6 Glutton Shackles and 3 Darksoul Shackles before I can assess the situation and devise a final solution for Arugal.  Now heed your bidding and slay Moonrage Gluttons and Moonrage Darksouls until you have what I need.
english.complete:
I hope I can acquire enough energy from such a limited sample.  Perhaps I should have had you get more shackles.

Nonetheless, you showed great skill in collecting these, <class>.
english.detail:
After examining Arugal's work my worst suspicions were confirmed.  The old hack was not qualified to clean chamber pots in Dalaran let alone represent the Kirin Tor in its most dire hour.  Fools!

Arugal used enchanted items to reinforce his weak magic.  I need to examine these items first hand.  Travel forth and slay Moonrage Gluttons and Moonrage Darksouls until you have collected enough of their enchanted shackles for my research.  The foul creatures have been seen to the north and east.

english.title: Arugal's Folly
english.objective: Kill Grimson the Pale and bring his head to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
english.progress: Has Grimson the Pale been slain?  Varimathras will not be pleased if we ignore his bidding.
english.complete: Most excellent.  The mine will provide superb resources for our forces as we spread throughout Silverpine and into Azeroth.
english.detail:
It will indeed take me longer than I had thought to uncover the dark secrets behind the enchantments Arugal was using.

But in the meantime I need you to take care of a slight problem our Darkstalkers have discovered.  It seems that Arugal let his magic spread to the Deep Elem Mine in the hills to the southeast.

The mine would prove to be quite a resource for Varimathras's advance.

I want you to behead the tainted foreman of the mine, Grimson the Pale.  With his death, the mine shall be ours.

english.title: Arugal's Folly
english.objective: Bring 6 Pyrewood Shackles to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
english.progress: Have you secured the Pyrewood Shackles yet, <name>?
english.complete: Your persistence is commendable.  With the knowledge you helped me gather, Arugal will fall and his reckless magic shall be undone.  Cheers to you, <name>.
english.detail:
As my understanding of Arugal's magic grows so does my disdain for the hapless fool.  I am close to completing my research on his so called remedy.

My knowledge will be complete when I learn what enchantment is causing the strange behavior going on in Pyrewood Village.  By day, the peasants appear to be Human.  But when the sun goes down the townsfolk turn into Moonrage Worgen.

I need to draw energy from the enchanted shackles Arugal cast on them.  Bring to me six enchanted Pyrewood Shackles, <name>.

english.title: The State of the Mines
english.progress: Do you have news from the mines?
